meta.name: implementing-api-security-testing-with-42crunch
meta.description: Implement comprehensive API security testing using the 42Crunch platform to perform static audit and dynamic conformance scanning of OpenAPI specifications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对API接口执行静态审计与动态扫描，发现安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责API接口安全，需要自动化审计和扫描OpenAPI规范
copy.tagline_en: Audit and scan your APIs statically and dynamically for security vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate security testing of your API specifications and implementations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能帮你分析OpenAPI规范文件，找出安全漏洞并给出修复建议，还能对运行中的API进行动态安全测试。
howto.when: 当你需要检查API的安全性，或者要求对OpenAPI规范做静态审计，或对运行中的API做动态扫描时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个OpenAPI文件的安全得分。
say.note: Claude会运行静态分析并报告漏洞。

say.text: 对运行中的API执行一次conformance扫描。
say.note: Claude会启动动态测试检测OWASP风险。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze your OpenAPI specification files, identify security vulnerabilities, provide remediation guidance, and perform dynamic security testing on running APIs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to check API security, request a static audit of an OpenAPI spec, or perform a dynamic conformance scan on a running API.

say_en.text: Audit this OpenAPI file for security score.
say_en.note: Claude runs static analysis and reports findings.

say_en.text: Run a conformance scan against the live API.
say_en.note: Claude initiates dynamic testing for OWASP risks.
